selection: Historical overview plus the lower-body, hoodie, glove and neck blockers; ranked for a short review.

videos.title: The full rider on the bike
videos.why: Start here for the overall dressed rider and in-game presentation. This is an older camera/control comparison, not proof that contact or animation has passed.

deliveryEncoding.reason: Sites per-file limit 25 MiB; H.264 CRF20 delivery copy, original unchanged

videos.title: Jeans and boots during a landing
videos.why: A short close-up of the lower body and boot construction comparison in a recorded landing. Watch the knee, trouser leg and boot around the footpeg; the trial remains unaccepted.

videos.title: Hoodie under arm movement
videos.why: The failed hoodie skinning trial shows why an attractive clothing source still needs deformation work. Watch the shoulder, sleeve and cuff as the arms move.

videos.title: Why the glove needs rebuilding
videos.why: The failed finger-flex prototype makes the broken finger construction easy to see. White material is diagnostic; this is not the intended black finished glove.

videos.title: The head and neck join
videos.why: The original and failed neck repair are shown together. Watch the side profile and head-to-body join; the numerical checks did not establish a visual pass.
